cases.title: Numeric value entry displays output and reveals elements
cases.description: Enter a numeric value in the height input field (data-testid='height-input') and verify that the value is displayed in the height output section (data-testid='height-output'), and that both the output row (data-testid='output-row') and the reset button (data-testid='reset-button') become visible.

cases.title: First dropdown selection updates placeholder and height name
cases.description: Select a unit from the first dropdown (data-testid='first-option-select') and verify that the input placeholder updates to 'Enter [Selected Unit]...' and the height name section (data-testid='height-name') displays '[Selected Unit]:'. Also test selecting the default 'Select an Option' to ensure placeholder reverts to 'Enter Height...' and the name section is empty.

cases.title: Second dropdown selection updates converted height name section
cases.description: Select a unit from the second dropdown (data-testid='second-option-select') and verify that the converted height name section (data-testid='converted-height-name') immediately updates to display '[Selected Unit]:'.

cases.title: End-to-end height conversion workflow
cases.description: Perform an end-to-end height conversion by entering a value in the height input, selecting 'from' and 'to' units via the respective dropdowns, and verifying that the final converted height result is correctly displayed in the output section (data-testid='final-output').

cases.title: Reset button clears inputs and hides dynamic elements
cases.description: Click the reset button (data-testid='reset-button') and verify that the height input field is cleared, the first dropdown is reset to 'Select an Option', the second dropdown is reset to 'Select', the output row is hidden, and the reset button itself is hidden.

opinions.feedback: All test cases are well-structured, distinct, cover all requirements effectively, and present no blockers.
All cases and requirements are clear, logically sound, and directly verifiable based on the provided test IDs and descriptions.

analysis.analysis: e2edev_bench_13-R-1: Testable behaviors include entering numeric values into 'height-input' and verifying display in 'height-output', as well as visibility changes for 'output-row' and 'reset-button'. Normal path: valid numeric input makes output section and reset button visible and reflects input. Abnormal/boundary paths: empty input, non-numeric input, negative numbers, or extremely large numbers. Ambiguities: handling of non-numeric values. e2edev_bench_13-R-2: Testable behaviors include selecting options from 'first-option-select' and verifying placeholder text updates in 'height-input' to 'Enter [Selected Unit]...' and 'height-name' displaying '[Selected Unit]:'. Normal paths: selecting Centimeters, Inches, Meters, Kilometers, Miles. Abnormal/boundary path: selecting default 'Select an Option', resetting placeholder to 'Enter Height...' and 'height-name' to empty. Ambiguities: handling of case sensitivity in unit names. e2edev_bench_13-R-3: Testable behaviors include selecting units from 'second-option-select' and checking 'converted-height-name' updates to '[Selected Unit]:'. Normal paths: selecting any valid unit option. Abnormal path: selecting the 'Select' default option. Ambiguities: exact text format if default is selected. e2edev_bench_13-R-4: Testable behavior encompasses general app overview, combining input, dropdowns, and output section 'final-output'. Normal path: end-to-end conversion workflow across supported units. Ambiguities: conversion formula accuracy and precision for decimals. e2edev_bench_13-R-5: Testable behaviors include clicking 'reset-button' to clear 'height-input', reset both dropdowns to defaults, and hide 'output-row' and 'reset-button'. Normal/abnormal paths: clicking reset when valid, invalid, or no input exists. Ambiguities: whether 'final-output' text is also cleared explicitly.
